<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|172|THE GOSPEL|CHA. XI.}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=11|verse=37}}† And vvhen he vvas speaking, a certaine Pharisee desired him that he vvould dine vvith him. and he going in sate dovvne to eate. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=38}}† And the Pharisee began to thinke vvithin him self and to say, VVhy he vvas not vvashed before dinner. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=39}}† And our Lord said to him, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 23, 25.''}}* Novv you Pharisees doe make cleane that on the out side of the cuppe and of the platter: but that of yours vvhich is vvithin, is ful of rapine and iniquitie. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=40}}† Fooles, did not he that made that on the outside, make that also that is on the inside? {{verse|chapter=11|verse=41}}† But yet c {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''Quod superest, τὰ ἐνόντα'',}}∷ that that remaineth, {{sup|‖}} giue almes, & behold al things are cleane vnto you. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=42}}† But vvo to you Pharisees, because you tithe minte and revve and euery herbe: and passe ouer iudgement and the charitie of God. but these things you ought to haue done, and not to omit those. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=43}}† Wo to you Pharisees, because you loue the first chaires in the synagogs, and salutations in the market-place. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=44}}† Wo to you, because you are as monuments that appeare not, and men vvalking ouer, are not vvare.

{{verse|chapter=11|verse=45}}† And one of the Lavvyers ansvvering saith to him, Maister, in saying these things, thou speakest to our reproche also. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=46}}† But he said, {{sup|‖}} Vvo to you Lavvyers also: because you lode men vvith burdens which they can not beare, and your selues touch not the packes vvith one of your fingers. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=47}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Gospel for many Martyrs.}}∷ Wo to you that {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Not the building of the Prophets monuments is condemned, but their imitation of their fathers that slew the Prophets. Ambros.}}∷ build the monuments of the Prophets: and your fathers did kil them. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=48}}† Surely you doe testifie that you consent to the vvorkes of your fathers: because they in deede did kil them, and you build their sepulchres. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=49}}† For this cause the wisedom also of God said, I vvil send to them Prophets and Apostles, and of them they vvil kil and persecute. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=50}}† that the bloud of al the Prophets that vvas shed from the making of the vvorld, may be required of this generation, {{verse|chapter=11|verse=51}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 4, 8.''}}* from the bloud of Abel vnto the {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''2. Par. 24, 22.''}}* bloud of Zacharie that vvas slaine betvvene the altar and the temple. Yea I say to you, it shal be required of this generation.⊣ {{verse|chapter=11|verse=52}}† Vvo to you Lavvyers, because you haue taken avvay the key of knovvledge: your selues haue not entred, and those that did enter you haue prohibited. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=53}}† And vvhen he said these things to them, the Pharisees and the Lavvyers began vehemently to vrge him, and to stoppe his mouth about many things, {{verse|chapter=11|verse=54}}† lying in waite for him, & seeking to catch some thing of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
